phantomstaff.config.title: Phantom Staff Slot
phantomstaff.config.comment.target_line_: Master switch for the target line (off by default). Toggle it right here - no keybind required. You may optionally bind Toggle Target Line as a shortcut.
Core color of the target line (ARGB).
Core width of the target line.
Maximum tracking distance of the target line in blocks.
Always render the target line through terrain. When off it is hidden by blocks.
Draw an arrow at the screen edge pointing at physics structures that are off-screen or behind you. Off leaves only the 3D line.
Draw a glowing outline box around the physics structure's bounding box, useful at long range or for small targets.
phantomstaff.config.comment.enable_phant: Swap the physics staff into your hand with a single key press (sends real packets, so the server recognises it); press again to swap back. Prefers the hotbar, then the main inventory; falls back to a client-side-only spawn if you carry no staff (server will not recognise it and left-click locking may kick you).
phantomstaff.config.comment.phantom_slot: Swap the physics staff into your hand, or swap it back (default B).
phantomstaff.config.comment.open_config_: Hotkey to open the Phantom Staff config menu (default G).
phantomstaff.config.comment.toggle_targe: Hotkey to toggle the target line (unbound by default, just an optional shortcut).
phantomstaff.msg.aeronautics_warning: [Phantom Staff] Server runs Create Aeronautics. The phantom staff slot swaps items with real vanilla packets, so the server recognises the staff in your hand.
